description: List the app's Time Machine state snapshots (restore points) and which state sources (storage/redux/zustand/jotai/react-query) can currently be captured/restored. Each snapshot also records the route it was captured on (shown as `route`), which a restore can navigate back to. Use time_machine_action to capture a snapshot before driving a flow, then restore supported sources to repeat the flow. Uncaptured and backend state can still differ.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: get_time_machine
